en.headline: Degree holders’ starting pay advantage over sub-degree graduates narrows
en.dek: A Baptist University survey found the gap between bachelor’s and sub-degree starting salaries fell to HK$2,500 this year from HK$3,000 last year.
body: Hong Kong Baptist University’s latest Greater Bay Area Pay and Benefits Survey showed the starting-pay gap between bachelor’s degree and sub-degree graduates narrowed to HK$2,500 this year.

The survey, released this week, found average starting salaries for recent bachelor’s graduates ranged from HK$17,500 to HK$23,000, while sub-degree graduates were between HK$15,500 and HK$20,500. The gap had been HK$3,000 last year.

Engineering roles offered the highest average starting salary for bachelor’s graduates at HK$23,000, up from the previous year. Human resources experts linked the narrower gap in part to the growing use of artificial intelligence in the workplace.
The same survey found average pay increases at Hong Kong companies slowed to 2.3 per cent this year, with many expecting a rebound next year.

zh.headline: 調查指學位與副學位畢業生起薪差距收窄至2500元
zh.dek: 浸會大學大灣區薪酬調查顯示，本科與副學位畢業生平均起薪差距由去年3000元降至今年2500元。
body: 香港浸會大學最新粵港澳大灣區薪酬及福利調查發現，本科學位與副學位畢業生的起薪差距今年收窄至2500元。
本周公布的調查指，應屆本科畢業生平均起薪介乎17500至23000元，副學位畢業生則介乎15500至20500元，去年差距為3000元。
工程職位為本科畢業生提供最高平均起薪23000元，較上年上升。人力資源專家認為，差距收窄部分與職場人工智能應用增加有關。
同一調查亦顯示，本港企業今年平均加薪幅度放緩至2.3%，不少受訪企業預期明年會回升。
